protocol.launch: parent process start to received first-swapped-Library marker with populated persisted collection; includes OS loader and observer scheduling, excludes launcher
protocol.scroll: 120 successive presented frames, contentY traverses the entire 24-photo grid; includes thumbnail loading
protocol.tap: synthetic thumbnail mouse press/release to swapped frame with ready current QML Image
protocol.render: same tap to last swapped current image, including QML viewport refinement; default 1280-pixel preview quality; no XMP edits
protocol.swipe: navigateImage(1), the recognized-swipe command, to swapped ready image; verified prepared neighbor; excludes gesture recognition
protocol.cache: fresh catalog per fixture; import outside timings; fresh process each round, persistent thumbnail cache and warm OS file cache
protocol.qml: same compiled Main.qml and components as darktable-touch; real native window; no physical touch or scanout measurement
